references.text: Describes the braided chains of pure gold that were to be made for the breastpiece, which here are attached to the rings.
Gives the original instructions for how the gold chains were to be attached to the breastpiece using the rings in the corners.
The immediate context describing the braided gold chains and the two gold rings that were made for the breastpiece.
Continuation of the description explaining how the other ends of the chains were attached to the ephod.
Instruction (Ex 28:24) and fulfillment (Ex 39:17) of the same specific construction detail.
Complementary instructions for how the ephod and breastpiece are fastened together as one unit.
